intakeController.title: Issue intake controller
intakeController.intro: This installation reads and triages issues on the platform repository only after an owner commissions it. Every check below must pass first.
intakeController.noRoom: No issue-triage room exists yet, so there is nothing to commission.

clause.locally-owned: The room belongs to this installation
clause.room-repository: The room is for that repository
clause.room-owner: The room has an owner here
clause.purpose: Developing the platform is its main or another job

intakeController.readOnly: Only someone who can manage the platform can commission issue intake.
intakeController.ownerConfirm: You become the owner of {$room}. This is recorded on the room.
intakeController.ownerConfirmHandover: You become the owner of {$room}. {$names} stays in the room but is no longer its owner. This is recorded on the room.

accountableOwner.label: Accountable owner:
accountableOwner.consequence: Every workroom without its own owner answers to this person.

oauthClientPeople.heading: People connected to {$client}
oauthClientPeople.dialogMessage: {$email} will be disconnected from {$client}. Everyone else stays connected. They can reconnect by signing in again. Why is their access ending?
oauthClientPeople.dialogPlaceholder: For example: setup account nobody uses

closeAuthorisation.heading: Let the acceptance sweep close finished work

summary.recordProblem: The saved setting cannot be used, so the sweep closes nothing.

closeAuthorisation.intro: Each morning the sweep checks work waiting for acceptance. When this is on, it closes the items that already pass every completion check, and nothing that needs a decision.
closeAuthorisation.recordProblem: The saved setting is incomplete or for something else, so the sweep closes nothing. Allow it again to fix it.
closeAuthorisation.lastRunNone: No sweep has run since closing was added.

offReason.malformed: the saved setting was incomplete. Allow it again to fix it.
offReason.outOfScope: the saved setting was for something else. Allow it again to fix it.
offReason.operatorNotAuthorised: the person who allowed it is no longer active or no longer manages the backlog. Someone with that permission needs to allow it again.
offReason.agentNotGranted: the Portfolio Advisor is no longer permitted to complete backlog items.
offReason.unavailable: the setting could not be read during that run. The next run tries again.
offReason.other: closing was off for that run.

closeAuthorisation.reasonHint: At least {$min} characters. It is kept with the record.
closeAuthorisation.limitDisclosure: Change how many it closes per run ({$limit})
closeAuthorisation.limitField: Most items to close in one run
closeAuthorisation.limitHint: 1 to {$max}. The rest wait for the next run.

consequence.summaryGrant: The next sweep closes items that pass every check.
consequence.what: The platform setting for the acceptance sweep.
consequence.who: Work waiting for acceptance. Each closure is recorded with your name and reason.
consequence.reversibilityGrant: You can stop it at any time. Items already closed stay closed.
consequence.reversibilityRevoke: Yes. Allow it again at any time.
consequence.recovery: Reopen a closed item from the backlog if it should not have closed.

closeAuthorisation.successGrant: Allowed. The next sweep can close items.
closeAuthorisation.successRevoke: Stopped. The next sweep closes nothing.
closeAuthorisation.notPermitted: You need permission to manage both the platform and the backlog to change this.

authorStagePreauthorisation.heading: Let agents run delivery stages within budget

summary.off: Author stages wait for a person.
summary.recordProblem: The saved setting cannot be used, so author stages wait for a person.

authorStagePreauthorisation.intro: When this is on, the Workroom drive gives a delivery room's author stages (design note, reproduce, implement) to the Software Engineer coworker, but only for work whose portfolio has a budget this quarter with points to spare. Merging, deploying and acceptance still wait for a person, and xlarge work never starts. When a room cannot run, the drive says why.
authorStagePreauthorisation.recordProblem: The saved setting is incomplete or for something else, so author stages wait for a person. Allow it again to fix it.
authorStagePreauthorisation.reasonHint: At least {$min} characters. It is kept with the record.

consequence.summaryGrant: The next drive run gives funded author stages to the Software Engineer coworker.
consequence.summaryRevoke: The next drive run sends author stages back to a person.
consequence.what: The platform setting the Workroom drive reads every run.
consequence.who: Delivery rooms whose work is funded within its portfolio's budget. The record keeps your name and reason.
consequence.reversibilityGrant: You can stop it at any time. Work already done stays done.
consequence.reversibilityRevoke: Yes. Allow it again at any time.
consequence.recovery: Stop it here; rooms then wait for a person on their next run.

authorStagePreauthorisation.successGrant: Allowed. The next drive run can give funded author stages to an agent.
authorStagePreauthorisation.successRevoke: Stopped. Author stages wait for a person.
authorStagePreauthorisation.notPermitted: You need permission to manage the platform to change this.

monitoringSettings.title: Monitoring
monitoringSettings.intro: Monitoring (Prometheus and Grafana) watches this platform and its host. You can turn it on or off at any time.

explain.on: Monitoring is running. Prometheus, Grafana and the database exporter are all up.
explain.off: Monitoring is off. Nothing is collecting metrics, and no memory or CPU is spent on it.
explain.turningOn: Monitoring is starting. This page updates when it finishes.
explain.turningOff: Monitoring is stopping. This page updates when it finishes.
explain.needsAttention: What is running does not match the setting.
explain.unreconciled: This install's capability records are incomplete or were written for another release, so monitoring cannot be changed safely yet.

reason.inFlight: A change is already in progress.
reason.installUnknown: The install state could not be read, so the switch is unavailable.
reason.enabledMissing: Monitoring is on, but these services are not running: {$services}
reason.disabledRunning: Monitoring is off, but these services are still running: {$services}

monitoringSettings.cost: Uses about {$memory} GB memory and {$cpus} CPU when on.
monitoringSettings.undecided: Nobody has chosen yet whether this install runs monitoring.
monitoringSettings.readOnly: You can see this setting, but changing it needs platform management access.
monitoringSettings.recordMismatch: The platform's record for monitoring does not match what is running. Matching it changes no services.

lastChange.heading: Last change
lastChange.none: No monitoring change has been requested on this install.

outcome.pendingVerification: The host applied the change, but it is not verified yet. Check again shortly.
outcome.inProgress: Another change is already in progress. Try again when it finishes.
outcome.drainRequired: Work that depends on monitoring is still running. Let it finish, then try again.
outcome.alreadyTerminal: This change was already handled. Refresh the page to see the result.
outcome.rolledBack: The change did not take, so the platform put things back as they were: {$failure} (change {$transitionId}).
outcome.rollbackFailed: The change failed and putting things back also failed: {$failure} (change {$transitionId}). Open runtime health.
outcome.recoveryRequired: An earlier change needs recovery before monitoring can be changed. Open runtime health.
outcome.hostStale: The install changed while this page was open. Refresh and try again.
outcome.databaseStale: The capability records changed while this page was open. Refresh and try again.
outcome.requestMismatch: The request no longer matches what the platform sees. Refresh and try again.
outcome.protocolUnavailable: The host's change tool could not be verified, so nothing was changed. Open runtime health.
outcome.unknown: The platform returned an answer this page does not recognise.
